stories.headline: The State Department Really Doesn’t Want to Talk About the Office of Remigration
stories.dek: The office was created a year ago and seemingly named for a far right European plan to expel minorities and immigrants from Western nations. It now works, a source says, with little to no oversight.

stories.headline: SOND, a sleep tech startup from Bose’s former head of sleep, exits stealth with $7M
stories.dek: SOND introduced its debut product: Dreambuds, a closed-loop, in-ear system that captures 12 physiological signals from the wearer, then acts on them in real time to help consumers get better sleep.
